items.title: AMIE, our research medical AI system, demonstrates real-time clinical video consultation capabilities in a first-of-its-kind study.
items.summary: Google's research medical AI system, AMIE, has successfully demonstrated real-time clinical video consultation abilities in a groundbreaking study, showcasing its potential for healthcare applications.

items.title: Knowing When Not to Reuse: Conditional Experience Transfer in Autonomous LLM Post-Training
items.summary: Researchers introduce a novel method for LLMs to conditionally transfer learned experiences, improving efficiency and performance in autonomous post-training by knowing when to apply or discard past knowledge.

items.title: Seattle Times and Newsday are the latest publications to sue OpenAI and Microsoft
items.summary: The Seattle Times and Newsday have joined other news organizations in suing OpenAI and Microsoft, alleging copyright infringement over the use of their content for training AI models.

items.title: RoboTok: An Internet-Scale Data Engine for Human Demonstration Retrieval and Dexterous Manipulation Learning
items.summary: A new internet-scale data engine, RoboTok, is presented to facilitate the retrieval of human demonstrations, significantly advancing dexterous manipulation learning for robotics.

items.title: OpenAI confirms ‘wiki incident,’ says it’s ‘working on a framework’ for more disclosure
items.summary: OpenAI has acknowledged a 'wiki incident' and announced plans to develop a new framework for increased transparency and disclosure regarding its AI models and operations.

items.title: Researchers use AI to ‘democratize’ 3D printing of crucial metal alloy
items.summary: Researchers have leveraged AI to make 3D printing of a critical metal alloy more accessible and efficient, potentially democratizing advanced manufacturing processes.

items.title: Hikers rescued after using Google Gemini for planning
items.summary: A group of hikers required rescue after relying on Google Gemini for their trip planning, highlighting potential risks and limitations of AI in critical real-world scenarios.

items.title: The Missing Temporal Link: Temporal Context Routing for Script-Driven Audio-Video Generation
items.summary: A new research paper addresses the challenge of generating coherent audio-video by introducing temporal context routing, enabling script-driven creation with improved consistency.

items.title: Beyond Retrieval: Progressive Latent Memory Evolution for Streaming Video Understanding
items.summary: This paper introduces a method for streaming video understanding that uses progressive latent memory evolution, moving beyond simple retrieval to better process continuous visual data.

items.title: NeoMME: A Single-Tower Multimodal-Native Multilingual Foundation Encoder for Efficient Fine-Tuning and Inference
items.summary: NeoMME presents a new single-tower foundation encoder designed for efficient fine-tuning and inference across multimodal and multilingual tasks, streamlining AI development.

items.title: RealSWE: A Compositional Evaluation of Coding Agents under Realistic User Requests
items.summary: RealSWE offers a new compositional evaluation framework for coding agents, assessing their performance against realistic user requests to better understand their capabilities and limitations.

items.title: WHALE: A Simple Recipe for Joint Harness-Weight Optimization
items.summary: WHALE proposes a straightforward method for jointly optimizing harness and weight in machine learning models, leading to more efficient and effective training.

items.title: Tree of Thoughts and MCTS for LLMs: What Happens When You Stop Making the Model Guess Once
items.summary: This article explores the application of Tree of Thoughts and Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to LLMs, demonstrating how these techniques can improve reasoning by moving beyond single-shot guessing.

items.title: ATV Big Air Tour turned 3 days of work into 3 hours with ChatGPT
items.summary: The ATV Big Air Tour team dramatically reduced their workload from three days to three hours by integrating ChatGPT into their operations, showcasing significant productivity gains.

items.title: How law firm Gilbert + Tobin governs and scales AI with OpenAI
items.summary: Law firm Gilbert + Tobin details its strategy for governing and scaling AI solutions using OpenAI technologies, providing insights into enterprise AI adoption and management.
